thresholds.note: The -1.9207 cutoff is the two-sided 95% / one-sided 97.5% descriptive likelihood-drop cutoff; -1.3528 is the one-sided 95% cutoff.

correction.interpolate_bound_error: The archived linear secant between eta=0 and eta=0.01 underestimated every upper bound because Delta ell(0.01) is hundreds to thousands of nats negative.
correction.profile_baseline: The archived profiled curve used null_train_nll at psi_hat(eta) instead of the uninhibited MLE psi_hat(0); the corrected curve subtracts each stored train_nll from the fixed x0 baseline.
correction.heldout_baseline: The archived held-out contrast subtracted a null evaluated at the eta-profiled parameters; the corrected contrast uses x0 = psi_hat(0).
